title: Sebastian and the Inventory
author: C. M. Reyes
blurb: Edmund Iversen, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
